name: Southern Vermont Arts Center Summer Camps
description_short: Summer camps for children and teens run by the Southern Vermont Arts Center in Manchester, VT. Camps are split into age groups: PreK–Kindergarten, Grades 1–3, Grades 4–6 and Grades 7–12.
refund_policy_summary: Refund requests are charged a 50% fee.
